symbols.name: mergeUnread
symbols.sig: export function mergeUnread(server: readonly number[], justOpened: ReadonlySet<number>): number[]
doc: I return what a person should see as new: the server's list, minus the circulars they have just opened and whose "read" is still being saved.

symbols.name: seedFor
symbols.sig: export function seedFor(status: VerifiedStatus, guestSeed: readonly number[] | null | undefined, alreadyAnswered: boolean): number[] | null
doc: What to show BEFORE the server has answered the first "which are unread for me" question: for a visitor who is known to be logged out, every recent circular is new (that is the rule for them), and the page already carries that list from the server, so I can show the red badge at once. I show nothing early for anyone logged in (their list needs their own answer, and a wrong number must never flash) or while it is not yet known who is looking, and nothing once a real answer has arrived. null = show nothing early.

symbols.name: initialUnread
symbols.sig: export function initialUnread(guestSeed: readonly number[] | null | undefined, certainlyLoggedOut: boolean): number[]
doc: I start the page with, even before any script runs, the server's list for a visitor who is CERTAINLY logged out (no login cookie), and with nothing otherwise.

members.name: unreadIds
doc: The ids of the circulars to show as new; the modal highlights these.

members.name: refresh
doc: Asks the server again (when the modal opens, when the viewer closes).

members.name: markOpened
doc: Call this when a circular is opened: it clears it at once (logged in), saves the read, then checks the server. Resolves true when the read was saved.

symbols.name: useCircularStatus
symbols.sig: export function useCircularStatus(status: VerifiedStatus, guestSeed?: readonly number[] | null, certainlyLoggedOut = false): CircularStatus

behaviours: nothing opened: the server's list as it is
a circular just opened is taken out (its read is still being saved: an older server answer must not bring it back)
an id the server does not list is ignored
an empty server list stays empty
the server's list itself is never changed
logged out + a list from the server: show that list at once
...the list handed back is a copy (the server's own array is never changed)
logged out + an empty list: nothing new to show
LOGGED IN: never shown early (their list needs their own answer; a wrong number must not flash)
not yet known who is looking: nothing early
a real answer has already arrived: the early list is never used again
no list from the server (it failed, or an old page): nothing early
no login cookie at all (certainly logged out) + a list: the page starts with that list
a login cookie exists (anyone might be behind it): the page starts with nothing
certainly logged out but no list from the server: nothing
the starting list is a copy
